boundary: the contrast and geometry gates still measure the list screen: neither opens a knowledge entry, so the detail panel's painted text is not what those two readings cover. This walk proves behaviour and round-trip, not legibility.

defectsFoundAndFixedByThisWalk.cause: collect() sent applicability/limits as `value.trim() || undefined`, so a blank box dropped the KEY, and the create/revise routes demand the exact key set
defectsFoundAndFixedByThisWalk.effect: a user who left either optional-looking box empty could not save at all, and the message was an unreadable code
defectsFoundAndFixedByThisWalk.fix: both keys always ride on the wire as empty strings; knowledge_library._text maps an empty one to the literal UNKNOWN

defectsFoundAndFixedByThisWalk.cause: the 许可状态 select had no unchosen state, so the served vocabulary's first entry (reviewed) was selected by default on a form nobody had touched
defectsFoundAndFixedByThisWalk.effect: an untouched 新增条目 form claimed the licence had been reviewed while the licence box was still empty, and the store refused the pair
defectsFoundAndFixedByThisWalk.fix: a fresh form defaults to unknown -- the state that says nobody has looked
